heard: A blind space probe navigated millions of miles alone. NASA launched the experimental $150 million mission to test new tech. It became the first spacecraft powered entirely by an ion engine. Then, its primary Star Tracker navigation system failed completely. Engineers urgently reprogrammed the science camera to act as its eye. The clever hack worked to keep the craft on course. Its ion engine ran for 16,265 hours in space. A blinded machine navigated millions of miles alone.
